title: Geonosian Fortress under Siege
front_description: Republic forces continue to fire on the escaping Trade Federation starships, which gradually lift into the sky. "Concentrate all your power on the nearest starship," Yoda instructs a clone commander. Finally. the Trade Federation fortress begins to weaken under the constant barrage or laser fire. The massive starship begins to fall, and eventually explodes in a tremendous fireball.
back_description: A production painting by Erik Tiemens depicting the Trade Federation starship's destruction.
